questions.prompt: Which ancient wonder stood in the harbor of Alexandria?
questions.fact: It stood over 100 metres tall and survived for more than 1,600 years before earthquakes finally brought it down.

questions.prompt: Which scientist first described the laws of planetary motion?
questions.fact: He found that orbits are ellipses rather than circles, overturning an assumption astronomy had held for 2,000 years.

questions.prompt: How many players are on the field for one soccer team at kickoff?
questions.fact: Eleven a side, one of them the goalkeeper — the only player allowed to handle the ball, and only inside their own area.

questions.prompt: Which film features the line 'May the Force be with you'?
questions.fact: The line appears in every film of the original trilogy, and the pun on 4 May is why that date became Star Wars Day.

questions.prompt: Which mountain range separates Europe from Asia?
questions.fact: This range is the conventional dividing line, which is why Russia counts as both a European and an Asian country.

questions.prompt: Which Roman poet wrote the Aeneid?
questions.fact: He asked for the poem to be burned, as he died before finishing it. Augustus overruled him.

questions.prompt: How many bits are in a byte?
questions.fact: Eight bits make a byte — 256 combinations, enough to cover every character in early text encodings.
